title: Production Package
description: DC-003-I033 — the canonical renderer-ready package used by every downstream rendering engine (Templated now; Canva/Adobe Express/Figma/HTML/PowerPoint later, per-renderer support isolated behind a Renderer Adapter), derived from exactly one immutable Social Media Package (DC-003-I032) via a pure, deterministic transformation — no AI/LLM call of any kind. Nothing after I033 needs to interpret marketing copy or editorial intent again. Deliberately renderer-agnostic at the top level: `headline_mapping`/`body_copy_mapping`/`cta_mapping`/`image_guidance_mapping` are generic per-slide content values, never a specific renderer's own literal layer names — a chosen Renderer Adapter resolves those separately, on demand, never persisted here. `template_id` names a renderer-agnostic template FAMILY (e.g. "dc-carousel-v1"), not a raw Templated template UUID. Immutable after creation: no update path exists; at most one Production Package may exist per social_media_package_id (see the Production Package Store's own duplicate-rejection rule).

production_package_id.description: Machine-generated, independent of social_media_package_id — mirrors every other DC-003 identifier convention (sm_/ep_/ic_/...).

social_media_package_id.description: The single, required input this package was derived from (DC-003-I032's Social Media Package Store). At most one Production Package may exist per social_media_package_id.

status.description: "generated" is the only value DC-003-I033 itself ever produces — mirrors social-media-package.schema.json's own identical status-field rationale, left open for a later milestone's own downstream lifecycle stages (e.g. "rendered").

renderer.description: The renderer this package was prepared for. Deliberately a narrow enum — only Templated has an implemented Renderer Adapter as of I033; extend this list only once a real adapter for another renderer exists (Canva/Adobe Express/Figma/HTML/PowerPoint), never speculatively.

platform.description: Optional, caller-supplied informational metadata (e.g. "instagram"). null when not specified — the source Social Media Package's own `carousel` content is platform-agnostic (shared across all four of its `platforms` text variations), so a platform association is never fabricated here, only honestly recorded when a caller actually supplies one.

design_id.description: Sourced from config/versions.json's own `design_system_version` at generation time (e.g. "dc-002-v1") — real, already-version-controlled metadata, never invented.

template_id.description: Names the renderer-agnostic template FAMILY this package's slide_sequence was mapped against (e.g. "dc-carousel-v1") — not a specific renderer's own literal template UUID. A chosen Renderer Adapter resolves this into that renderer's real per-slide template identifiers (see templated-renderer-adapter.mjs).

slide_sequence.description: Exactly six slides, 1:1 with the source Social Media Package's own six-entry `carousel` arrays, in the same order — no reordering, no slide-type classification invented (unlike the older, now-superseded six-heterogeneous-template carousel pipeline — see this schema's own top-level description and the DC-003-I033 README section "Investigation" for why).

rendering_metadata.description: Documents HOW slide_sequence was produced — distinct from the identity fields above (renderer/template_id/design_id/platform).

validation_metadata.description: A record of what was actually checked at generation time — mirrors this project's own established "capture what you verified" discipline rather than asserting correctness silently.

social_media_package_checksum.description: Copied from the source Social Media Package's own `checksum` at generation time, for traceability — proves which exact version of the source this package was derived from.

renderer_mapping_validated.description: True only when the chosen Renderer Adapter's own mapToRendererPayload() was successfully exercised (not merely assumed) against this package's slide_sequence during generation — see production-package-generator.mjs.

production_checksum.description: Self-integrity checksum for this record itself — mirrors ingested-content.mjs/editorial-package.mjs/social-media-package.mjs's own identical discipline (computed over the record before this field is added).

cta_mapping.description: Non-null only on the slide carrying the call to action (slide_number 6, mirroring the older carousel pipeline's own "CTA is always the last slide" convention) — sourced verbatim from the Social Media Package's own top-level call_to_action field, never rewritten.

placeholder_tag_mapping.description: The same four values above, re-keyed under a stable, renderer-agnostic tag vocabulary (headline/body/cta/image_guidance) rather than this schema's own field names — ready for a future tag-substitution-style renderer adapter (e.g. PowerPoint/Figma placeholder text) to consume directly without needing to know this schema.
